_README: Big Sarge's commentary, one entry per game. Key is the game id: season_week_AWAY_HOME, e.g. 2026_03_KC_BUF. Value is your take, plain text. Leave a value empty and nothing renders for that game.
_HOW: Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/build_2026.py games.csv index.html  Rebuilding pulls fresh scores and keeps every word you wrote, because your commentary lives here and not in index.html.
_IDS: Every game id follows the same pattern, so you can add any game in any week without looking it up. Week 3's slate is listed below, ready to fill in.
2026_03_ATL_GB: Short week, long flight, and a Lambeau crowd waiting on them. Atlanta's 0-2 and now they head north to a Packers team that's already found its legs. Green Bay by a touchdown, and it won't feel that close late.
2026_03_LAC_BUF: Buffalo's 2-0 and at home. The Chargers are 0-2 and still hunting for answers they haven't found. Bills stack another one and it isn't dramatic.
2026_03_CAR_CLE: Two 1-1 teams that both think they're one game from figuring it out. Cleveland's home, so I'll give the Browns the edge, but this is a rock fight into the fourth quarter.
2026_03_NYJ_DET: Detroit at home off a split is a dangerous animal. The Jets can hang for a half, but the Lions have more juice in the tank. Detroit pulls away late.
2026_03_HOU_IND: Division game and both these teams are 0-2 and desperate. Somebody walks out at 1-2 feeling alive again. Colts have the home field, so Indy gets off the mat.
2026_03_NE_JAX: Even money on paper, both sitting 1-1. Jacksonville's home and that's the tiebreaker for me. Jags grind out a close one.
2026_03_KC_MIA: Kansas City's 2-0, Miami's 0-2 and hurting. The Chiefs don't have to be fancy here, they just have to be themselves. KC handles business.
2026_03_TEN_NYG: The Giants are 1-0 and protecting home turf. Tennessee's 0-2 and still checking for a pulse. New York takes this one.
2026_03_CIN_PIT: This is the one circled on the AFC North calendar. Bengals roll in at 2-0, Pittsburgh's home at 1-1, and nobody in this rivalry gives an inch. Give me Cincinnati by a field goal, but bank on it going to the wire.
2026_03_SEA_WAS: Seattle's 2-0 and rolling. Washington's 0-2 and it shows on tape. Seahawks keep it clean on the road.
2026_03_ARI_SF: NFC West, and the 49ers are 2-0 at home. Arizona's frisky at 1-1 but San Francisco is the class of this matchup right now. Niners hold serve.
2026_03_MIN_TB: Minnesota's 2-0 and playing with its chest out. Tampa's 0-2 and pressing. Vikings take care of it.
2026_03_BAL_DAL: Football in Brazil, neutral turf at the Maracana, two 1-1 teams under the lights. No home crowd, no comfort, just execution. I'll take Baltimore to be the more disciplined team when it matters.
2026_03_LV_NO: The Raiders are the early-season surprise at 2-0. New Orleans is 1-1 at home and won't lie down for anybody. Vegas keeps the magic alive, barely.
2026_03_LAR_DEN: Denver's home at 1-1, the Rams are 0-1 and still shaking off the rust. Mile High is a bad place to go looking for your footing. Broncos by a score.
2026_03_PHI_CHI: Monday night, Eagles march into Chicago at 2-0 and the Bears get their prime-time shot at 1-1. Philadelphia's the more complete team, but a loud night at Soldier Field keeps Chicago breathing into the fourth. Eagles escape.
